F1.evidence: The declared set holds the stylesheets' small :root palette verbatim (27 names: --secondary-blue #0061ef, --primary-blue #0040ea, --orange #ff7e1d, --yellow #ffce00, --grey-for-bg #faf8f4, --2ndary-warm-grey-100 #f9f4f2, --primary-warm-grey-700 #2d2c2b, --silver-for-divider, red/green/blues), and light.color carries the measured brand/action/ink values that cross-check them. No per-hue ramp scale exists in the source stylesheets — Headspace compiles to Emotion classes, so ramp steps beyond the ~27 declared names are not published.

F2.evidence: light.color.surface has page (#f9f4f2 warm wash), header (#fff), field (#fff), auth-card (#fff) and footer-panel (#44423f). Raised/overlay/scrim roles are not separated as semantic tokens — the mega-menu and drawers paint the same surfaces.

F3.evidence: light.color.ink has primary #4b4c4d, muted #44423f, nav #2d2c2b and footer; brand.on-blue covers on-accent. Disabled and destructive text roles are not reachable signed-out.

F4.evidence: light.color.line has field #d2d5de and the redeem field's dark border; accent.focus #101010 covers the focus ring. A distinct strong/hairline border role is not published as a separate token on the public surfaces.

F5.evidence: Primary pills measured in default, hover (#0061ef->#0040ea), focus-visible and forced-pressed (hero-cta, redeem-button, auth-continue, subscribe-button #2d2c2b->#141313, auth-sso tertiary #f9f4f2->#e5e7ec, org-cta white->#ff7e1d) in raw/components-computed.json.

F6.evidence: The declared palette includes --red #e85d4a and --green #01a652, but no status component (error banner, success, warning) paints on any signed-out surface; form error states were never triggered.

F7.evidence: Every captured surface ships a single light theme: no theme control, no dark attribute, no applied prefers-color-scheme rules (raw/css-vars.json, raw/motion.json probes). All semantic roles exist within light; no parity gap exists because no second theme paints.

F8.evidence: core.font.family (display/body/nav = 'Headspace Apercu', plus the Apercu Pro Mono @font-face record in raw/css-vars.json's 243 faces), a measured size scale (64px display through caption), weights (the shipped 200/400/600/700) and line-heights, each with component provenance.

F10.evidence: core.radius: button 32px, pill 800px, field 8px, field-sm 4px, all measured on the real controls.

F11.evidence: core.layout has the 1447px container, header heights 80px/64px, and component sizes are per-entry in components.md (header 1440x80, promo strip 1440x26, auth card padding 40). A named size/target scale is not published.
